title: GUESS THE FLAG
ask: Which country does this flag belong to?

questions.fact: An eagle eats a snake on a cactus|🦅
Five stripes and one white star|⭐
Woodcutters stand by a mahogany tree|🌳

yt.title: Guess These 5 Flags From North & Central America
yt.description:
Canada's maple leaf is the warm-up; Belize's woodcutters and Nicaragua's five volcanoes are where it gets tricky. How many of these North and Central American flags did you get? 👇
